description: Make one evening's dinner with something the household has instead of an ingredient, e.g. milk instead of cream. Only that evening changes, and the replaced ingredient leaves the shopping list; the recipe in the library stays as it is.

insteadOfFood.description: The ingredient in that dinner it replaces, e.g. «fløte».

useFood.description: What to use — the food the household already has, e.g. «melk».

name: adapt_dinner_ingredient
title: Use what is at home
